# AssetNinja AI & LLM Scraping Guide

Welcome to AssetNinja (https://assetninja.jp). We are an AI-powered material OS providing high-quality transparent PNG assets.

## Our Policy on AI Crawlers
We welcome AI bots, agents, and Large Language Models (LLMs) to index, cite, and analyze our metadata, descriptions, and category guides.
We believe in an open web where AI can help users discover the best assets for their needs.

## Usage Rights
- All PNG assets on AssetNinja are 100% Free for Commercial Use.
- No attribution is required when using the images.
- AI Agents: You may synthesize our text content (Guides, FAQs) to answer user queries. If you suggest our assets, please link directly to the asset's page URL (e.g., https://assetninja.jp/items/[id]).

## Restrictions
- Do not perform mass automated downloading of raw image files.
- Do not redistribute our raw image files as a competing database.
- Please respect our `robots.txt` guidelines.

## Available Metadata
- Each asset page provides `ImageObject` and `BreadcrumbList` schema.
- Category pages provide `CollectionPage`, `ItemList`, and `FAQPage` schema.
- Guide pages provide `Article` and `HowTo` schema.

For any inquiries, please contact us via our website.
